description: Figure 8 presents four separate pie charts showing the distribution of language models’ answer refusal categories on FACTBENCH, with one pie per model (GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct), for a total of four pies; each pie uses colored slices with category labels and percentage values printed inside the slices, and there is no separate legend. The GPT4-o pie has 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in red at about 83.3% and “Safety Concerns” in light orange at about 16.7%. The Gemini1.5-Pro pie has 6 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in dark blue at about 32.1%, “Ethical Advice” in medium blue at about 14.3%, “Clarification” in light blue at about 12.4%, “Misinformation” in orange at about 30.0%, “Safety Concerns” in red at about 5.7%, and “Other” in gray at about 5.4%. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct pie has 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in orange at about 87.0% and “Clarification” in red at about 13.0%. The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct pie has 2 slices split evenly: “Lack of Knowledge” in red at about 50.0% and “Misinformation” in orange at about 50.0%; none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
